summary_1line: Grieving Nimi performs a novel rite for his dead son; Atri explains it as the divinely ordained Sraddha ritual and details its proper rules and prohibitions.

image_candidates.scene_text: The grieving sage Nimi offers rice cakes on kusa grass to his deceased son while seven Brahmanas sit before him on seats of sacred grass.
The sage Atri suddenly appears before the sorrowful Nimi in his forest hermitage to reassure him about the sacred rite he has performed.
Nimi carefully spreads blades of kusa grass with their tips pointing south while preparing offerings for the Pitris during the new moon ritual.
